analyst.summary: Jindal Stainless is India's largest stainless steel maker, supplying automakers, railways, construction and consumer-durable manufacturers. The business delivered steady revenue growth and strong profit growth this past year on stable margins, and is actively expanding capacity, funded by a mix of manageable new borrowing and its own healthy cash generation. Promoters have been increasing their stake, and working-capital efficiency has genuinely improved. The stock is reasonably priced for the growth and quality on offer, but stainless steel remains a cyclical, commodity-input-exposed business. We rate it a Hold: a well-run sector leader at a fair price, not a bargain and not overextended.
